why: RJ-L54 (catalog-backup BK-5): rates the 30 photos of a catalog ten at a time, saving after each rating on the job's clock (1790000000, then an hour and two hours later), so each save keeps a backup; then truncates catalog.json and relaunches, which opens the newest good backup with all 30 ratings and names it; restoring the oldest backup brings back its ten ratings, and catalog.backups then lists the pre-restore catalog as the newest backup. Pending #3741: the CLI keeps file commands window-only and has no clock, truncation or relaunch; LibraryBackupJobTests runs these steps on Linux, saving after each metadata.set-rating.
